description: Defines classes and interfaces for BufferHub service, including BufferHubChannel, BufferHubService, and related data structures, used for buffer management in Android DVR.

classes.name: BufferHubChannel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel for buffer management, supporting different channel types such as producer, consumer, and queue channels.

classes.name: BufferHubService
classes.description: Main service class managing buffer lifecycle, message handling, and state dumping for BufferHub.

classes.name: BufferInfo
classes.description: Data structure capturing buffer metadata for producer buffers and queues.

methods.name: DumpState
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current state of BufferHub for debugging.

methods.name: OnCreateBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new buffer with specified parameters.

methods.name: OnCreateProducerQueue
methods.description: Creates a producer queue with specified configuration.
